items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And Joe eventually got to, after he left Basie, he went with Bill Robinson.

ctx.x: Yes. Herschel always looked like a real dignified lawyer or..... Beautifully dressed. He wouldn't go out that everything was in, everything was in line before he would go out.

And Joe eventually got to, after he left Basie, he went with Bill Robinson. Bill Robinson liked him, bought him a new trumpet. But by that time he was on, drinking wine, he was a wino, in the Braddock Hotel.

So he got to hanging out with these guys that were drinking to death. Everytime he'd get some money they'd drink it up. And he got worse and worse until he was finally sleeping in the street. So he sent home to Texas and his mother sent him something like two hundred dollars. So he lets, buys all these cronies drinks and wine. Everybody knew he had some money.
